flow: ui-path — type the query into the site's own search box and press Enter so gmail's own JS runs the search; read the rendered results

steps.note: Must run in a logged-in session; otherwise the site 302s to accounts.google.com (measured 2026-09-23).
Known-stable Gmail search-box surface (DOM-UNVERIFIED — re-tune on first capture). Real keystrokes so gmail's own input handlers receive them, then Enter.
Gmail's own JS fetches + renders the results (the URL hash becomes #search/<q>). Read the same row surface as gmail_read_inbox. DOM-UNVERIFIED.
Same per-row fields (subject .y6, sender .bog, snippet .y2, date .xW). Empty result = 0 rows returned honestly.

output.rows: array<{id, subject, sender, snippet, dateTag, unread}>

rpc: none — RPC bridge deliberately not driven; the page's own JS performs the search
stealth: real typing + Enter in the site's own search box — indistinguishable from a human searching
